sources: https://www.parsonsks.com/lake-parsons, read 2026-11-06: 'Beautiful Lake Parsons is a peaceful retreat for campers, a fun-filled beach for summer swimmers, and a sportsman's paradise for hunting and fishing. This year-round recreational area draws visitors from across the region.'; 'Spend up to 12 days camping in our improved campsite area with RVs or traditional camping in tents. For Lake Parsons Camping information, please call 620-421-7000 . Throughout the summer months, a camp host is on duty for the convenience of campers. There is a bath house at the lake as well.'

https://www.parsonsks.com/campsite-permit-fees, read 2026-11-06: 'Lake Parsons has improved and primitive campsites available. You must get a permit from the City Clerk's Office.'; 'Campsites with electricity & water $18 [daily] $300 [annual]'; 'Tent campsites without electricity $5 $25'; 'There is currently no charge for camping in areas where no improved pad is available.'; 'No person or member of the same household shall be permitted to occupy a camping space for more than 12 total days in a calendar month and not more than 12 consecutive days at any time. Check-out time will be 2:00.'

RV Life park 263192 (4 stars, 1 rating; geoloc 37.39895,-95.34737 = the entrance road) review, read 2026-11-06: 7/2024 fifth wheel, '$30 USD a night', site 'Lake front back_in', 'You have to drive down about 2 miles of unpaved road: Great fishing lake, there is a boat ramp and docks in the camp site.'

Web search summary of The Dyrt / Campendium / ParkAdvisor listings, 2026-11-06 (aggregators, not relied on for values): concrete slabs with tables, 50-amp on only one side of the camping area, a 2019 reviewer saying some sites sit right on the water; ParkAdvisor phone 620-421-7093.

Esri World Imagery at the stored pin and along the access road (220-600 m half-widths), 2026-11-06: the camping area is a wooded peninsula on the lake's south shore (~37.4060-37.4075, -95.3505 to -95.3460) with a loop road, boat docks, a playground and a white building; pads are under canopy. The stored pin sits at the water's edge on the peninsula's east tip.

values.note: No reservations: buy a daily ($18) or annual ($300) camping permit from the City Clerk's Office. Up to 12 consecutive days and 12 days in a calendar month; check-out 2:00.

booking.source: https://www.parsonsks.com/campsite-permit-fees ('You must get a permit from the City Clerk's Office'; 'not more than 12 consecutive days at any time'), read 2026-11-06

note: City of Parsons lake NW of Parsons in Labette County, reached by about 2 mi of unpaved road: an improved campsite area of concrete-slab sites with electric and water on a wooded peninsula, with boat ramp and docks, playground, bath house and a summer camp host; free primitive camping where there is no pad. Permits from the City Clerk ($18 a day, $300 a year), no reservations, 12-day limit. --Claude
summary: City pages read: $18 E/W sites (and $300 annual) by clerk permit, no reservations, 12-day limit written, bath house + summer host. Waterfront not waterfront -> lakeview (sites under canopy along the shore; camper reports of lakefront sites are a lead). Pin at the water's edge; proposed move.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakeview (lead for lakefront): the campsite peninsula's loop road runs ~10-25 m from the shore with docks and a ramp, but the pads are under tree canopy, so imagery cannot confirm an open apron. A 7/2024 RV Life camper's site was 'Lake front', and a 2019 Dyrt review (via search summary) says some sites sit right on the water - contrary to the stored 'not waterfront', so the gate was re-run; without a photo or site map showing pads at the water, lakeview is as far as the evidence goes. Weak spot.

PIN MOVE: stored 37.4063,-95.3460 is at the water's edge on the east tip of the camping peninsula. Proposed 37.4070,-95.3498 (the main loop by the docks and the white building, ~340 m west); campsite positions are not mapped by the city, so this is approximate.
MAX STAY: city ordinance on the permit page = 12 consecutive days and 12 days per calendar month (written).
HOOKUPS: electric 50 left as stored (derived) but unconfirmed - the city pages say only 'electricity & water'; aggregators say 50-amp on one side only. Water written from the city page.
ANNUAL PERMIT: $300/year electric sites (and the 12-days-a-month rule) caps long stays, so no seasonal-resident concern.

PHONE 620-421-7000 confirmed (city page: 'For Lake Parsons Camping information, please call'); Google/ParkAdvisor give 620-421-7093 (likely the lake office or host line, not confirmed). WEBSITE https://www.parsonsks.com/lake-parsons as stored; https://www.parsonsks.com/campsite-permit-fees is the fee page.
SAND: none. ACCESS: ~2 mi of unpaved road (gravel, a fifth wheel managed it).
